## Skill Submission Checklist

Please ensure all items are checked before submitting:

- [ ] SKILL.md follows the required format with YAML frontmatter
- [ ] metadata.json validates against schema
- [ ] README.md documents usage clearly
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md includes version history
- [ ] Skill name is unique and not already in the marketplace
- [ ] All required metadata fields are filled accurately
- [ ] Skill has been tested locally
- [ ] No sensitive information (passwords, API keys, secrets) included
- [ ] License is compatible (MIT, Apache, BSD, etc.)
- [ ] Code of conduct acknowledged
